text:
jamie_marketing: Quick experiment idea — Launch a pricing "thermometer" on the pricing page + refreshed tier names + a tiny inline estimator. Goal: increase qualified demo signups and route high-intent leads into a webinar funnel. Thoughts?

maria: Sounds good. What's the primary KPI here — demo conversion or MQL velocity? :thinking:

sam: Primary KPI: demo conversion rate from pricing page + % who choose contact-sales vs self-serve. We'll A/B names and CTAs.

alex: For routing: if someone selects the top tier or estimator shows > $5k/mo, route to SDR and offer immediate webinar invite. Else lower-touch flows. Need to capture utm + company_size.

leo: Copy idea: CTA "Estimate monthly cost in 10s" + a micro-FAQ toggle under the estimator. Add a small opt-in checkbox "Invite me to a webinar on cost optimization". :memo:

maria: How complex should the estimator be? Keep it lightweight — 2 fields: monthly tokens and concurrency slider. Output: cost band + recommended tier. No billing calc.

jamie_marketing: Prototype routing snippet (proto):
```yaml
rules:
  - if: tier_selection == "Enterprise" or estimated_cost >= 5000
    action: route_to_sales_sdr
  - if: estimated_cost >= 1000 and estimated_cost < 5000
    action: invite_to_product_webinar
  - else:
    action: self_serve_flow
```
We capture events and surface as GA + internal conversion.

sam: Event list to add to backlog: pricing_estimator_start, pricing_estimator_submit, pricing_tier_click, pricing_webinar_opt_in. Also need variant tag for tier_name_test.{A,B} in experiments table.

ops-bot: Reminder: experiments require feature flag + analytics flagging. Create FF: pricing_thermometer_v1 and set to 10% rollout initially.

alex: Messaging variants for the webinar invite to test: "Sign up for a 30-min walkthrough — learn cost-saving knobs" vs "Get a live demo + pricing review". We'll measure qualified leads from each.

jamie_marketing: Owners: jamie -> experiment brief + creative; sam -> analytics + A/B setup; maria -> micro-FAQ updates + visuals; alex -> routing & SDR mapping; leo -> CTA copy + microcopy. Target go-live for first iteration in 1 week (3002004056). Anyone blocked?

sam: No blockers. I'll add events to the analytics board and start the experiment skeleton.

maria: I'll ping legal about estimator language (avoid promise of exact bill). Also will draft the micro-FAQ entries.

leo: I'll drop CTA options and 2 tier-name variants in this thread by EOD.

jamie_marketing: Nice — I'll create the PRD and post link here when ready: https://docs.internal/redwood/pricing-thermometer-v1 :rocket: 

alex: One more ask — add a hidden input for company_size buckets in the estimator so routing rules can use it.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7890: "pricing thermometer experiment infra" and assigned to eng-plat.

jamie_marketing: Great progress. Will sync with growth tomorrow 11am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
